name: Esports Team Manager
detailed_description:
The world's most realistic esports management game.

Hire your staff, manage star players, and even set the price of hot dogs - you're in complete control!

Take charge of the worst team in the league and guide them to glory, or pick the top dogs and roll through the brackets. Play through an entire season packed with preseason, splits, playoffs, international competitions, and a fully immersive offseason complete with free agency, retirements, and more.

How you build your team is entirely up to you. Do you have what it takes to win it all?

Game Features

  • In-depth Players: Sign players with diverse stats and attributes, crafting the perfect roster to match your playstyle and team synergy.

  • Day-to-Day Decisions: Balance player rest and training intensity, which teams to scrimmage against, or encourage team bonding - every decision affects performance.

  • Long-term Strategy: Face tough choices like going into debt to keep your stars, or rebuilding from the ground up after a disappointing season.

  • Full GM/Owner Control: Set ticket and merchandise prices, hire or fire your entire staff - from coaches and analysts to managers - and juggle facilities, sponsors, and more as you assemble the ultimate dream team.

  • Infinite Replayability: Choose from several unique teams and play through unlimited seasons, navigating random events, unexpected injuries, and even social media scandals.

Are you ready to become the GOAT of esports management? Prove it in Esports Team Manager!
